issue.title: Retire admin_center_config_hub
issue.description: Opt-in beta: Config becomes a nested catalog of XPrompts, Snippets, Glossary, Memory, and Misc, and prompt shortcuts open those children inside the Admin Center.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Nested navigation, contextual entry, visual snapshots, and full-suite acceptance checks pass so the enabled route can become unconditional.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The seven-section Admin Center and standalone prompt-opened Glossary, Memory, and Snippets panels remain available.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: The six-section Admin Center and nested Config catalog own XPrompts, Snippets, Glossary, Memory, and Misc, and prompt shortcuts open the matching Config child.
